title: The Core Verbs
label: ch:te-core-verbs
canDo: I can build a Telugu verb as stem plus tense plus person, say why one form covers both "I go" and "I will go", give a polite command with -aṇḍi, and explain why ఉండు has to borrow its negative and తెలుసు has no person at all.

payoff.summary: Say నాకు తెలుసు, name the three slots that built uṇṭānu, veḷtānu and cūstānu, separate it from Chapter 6's నాకు తెలుగు వచ్చు — fact against skill — and recall that ఉండు switches to lē- to be negated.
